content: Namo guru mañjughoṣāya!From the heart of the Lord of the hundreds of deities of Tuṣita,Upon the crest of clouds like a mound of fresh, pure white curd,O Dharma King, omniscient Blo-bzang-grags-pa,Together with your spiritual sons, I pray you come to this place.In the sky before me, upon a lion throne, lotus, and moon,Is the venerable Guru, radiant with a joyful, white smile.As the supreme field of merit for my faithful mind,I pray you remain for a hundred eons to cause the teachings to flourish.Your wisdom mind perceives the entire expanse of all that can be known,Your eloquent speech is an ornament for the ears of the fortunate,Your body is resplendently beautiful with the glory of renown,I prostrate to you, whom to see, hear, or remember is meaningful.Delightful drinking water, various flowers,Fragrant incense, bright lamps, scented water, and more—This ocean of offering clouds, both actually arranged and mentally emanated,I offer to you, the supreme field of merit.Whatever non-virtuous actions of body, speech, and mindI have accumulated since beginningless time,And in particular, all that is contrary to the three vows,I confess individually with intense and heartfelt regret.In this degenerate age, you were diligent in extensive learning and practice,Abandoning the eight worldly concerns, you made this precious human life meaningful.O Protector, in your magnificent deeds,We rejoice from the very depths of our hearts.O holy and venerable gurus,In the sky of the dharmakāya, clouds of wisdom and compassion gather;Upon the earth of disciples, just as is appropriate,Please let fall the spontaneously present rain of Dharma.By this virtue that I have accumulated,Whatever is of benefit to the teachings and all beings,And in particular, may the essence of the teachingsOf the venerable Blo-bzang-grags-pa long be illuminated.Avalokiteśvara, great treasure of objectless compassion,Mañjughoṣa, master of stainless wisdom,Lord of Secrets, who subdues the entire host of Māra,Tsongkhapa, crowning jewel of the scholars in the Land of Snows,At the feet of Blo-bzang-grags-pa, I offer my prayer.Thus, in the center of the vast sky of white clouds,Having well meditated upon the venerable Guru, father and sons,By the power of this prayer offered with intense, longing devotion,May the darkness of ignorance be uprooted and cast away.Grant me the wisdom to engage all scriptures without obstruction,Peerless in revealing all the difficult essential points,Swiftly cutting through non-realization, misconception, and doubt,Bestow upon me wisdom that is profound, clear, and swift.May all phenomena that I examine and analyze,Be held in memory, capable of being retained for eons;Grant me the supreme, unsurpassed dhāraṇī of words and meaning,And cause it to be accomplished in my mind this very day.May I attain the rank of a peerless scholar,Like Ārya-Siṃha, in expounding the intended meaningOf the ocean of Perfection of Wisdom scriptures,Such as the *Abhisamayālaṃkāra*, the great Mother of the Victors.Regarding the stainless scriptures of the great charioteer Nāgārjuna and his spiritual sons,Such as the *Root* and *Introduction* and the *Four Hundred*,May I not merely rely on mental conjecture regarding the Madhyamaka treatises,But may I gain certainty through the power of valid cognition.Regarding the treatises of the brothers Asaṅga and Vasubandhu,Which reveal all the specifically and generally characterized definitions of the five grounds,May I gain deep-seated certainty through scripture and reasoning,And reach the far shore of the ocean of Abhidharma.May the teachings alone be the gateway for those desiring liberation,And may I, having fully grasped the Seven Treatises on valid cognition along with the Sutras,Which serve as the means of proof,Attain the rank of a preeminent leader in debate, capable of refuting all opponents.The supreme gateway for proceeding to the city of liberation,The root of the teachings, the scriptures of the hundred thousand sections of Vinaya,May I realize all of the Sage’s speech along with the commentaries,And always seek them through the conduct of conscientiousness.Subduing those who speak falsely through grammar and logic,And caring for the fortunate through craftsmanship, medicine, poetics, and the like,May I be like Mañjughoṣa in expressing, just as they are,All the fields of knowledge that are the feast of the learned.In short, may I become fully proficient in all the Sage’s scriptures,And in the vast treatises of the great pioneers, the Six Ornaments and the Two Supreme Ones,Having thus refined my intelligence in these infinite texts,May I uphold the victory banner of the teachings of study and practice.May all adverse conditions, epidemics, demons, and obstacles,That obstruct my attainment of enlightenment,And especially all types of illnesses that disturb the heart,Be swiftly pacified through the remembrance of your feet.When the formations of life are relinquished and the vital points are severed,May all the terrors and fears of the bardo and the Lord of Death be pacified,And having been born in the Dharma palace of Ganden or the celestial realm,May I behold the face of the Gentle Protector, Father and Sons.When you, Protector, attain Buddhahood in a wondrous array,May I become the foremost of your retinue,And having perfected the conduct of the Bodhisattvas’ skillful means,May I become like the lion’s roar of the Victorious One.
